verdict.rationale: Column's own docs say users can configure webhook endpoints, via the API or the Dashboard, to be notified about events. That is a documented, registrable outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. Only a single doc line covers it, with no depth on event types, signing, retries or delivery guarantees. missing for 10: event type catalog, signature verification/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can configure webhook endpoints via APIs or Dashboard in your platform to be notified about events from Column.
